name: Tutorial UI
description: UI interaction spec for the interactive guided tutorial overlay with 13 steps.

dom.tooltip: .tutorial-tooltip (position:absolute; max-width:360px; padding:16px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); pointer-events:auto; font-size:12px)
dom.highlight_ring: .tutorial-ring (position:absolute; border:2px solid var(--accent); border-radius:8px; pointer-events:none; z-index:3999; box-shadow:0 0 0 9999px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))
structure: .tutorial-tooltip-extra (custom content area, optional, defined by step.renderExtra)
button.tutorial-btn (padding:4px 10px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:11px)

interactions.name: start_tutorial
interactions.action: Reset to step 0, show overlay, render current step

interactions.name: next_step
interactions.action: Call prev step.onLeave, increment index, call next step.onEnter, re-render

interactions.name: back_step
interactions.action: Call prev step.onLeave, decrement index, call next step.onEnter, re-render

interactions.name: done
interactions.trigger: Click Done button (last step) or arrow-key right past last step
interactions.action: Call step.onLeave, hide overlay, call onFinish callback

interactions.name: skip
interactions.action: Immediately hide overlay, call onFinish without completing remaining steps

interactions.name: target_highlight
interactions.action: Query target element, create highlight ring matching its bounding rect. Reposition on resize/scroll.
interactions.overflow: If step.overflowHidden, set body overflow:hidden until step changes

interactions.name: extra_content
interactions.action: Call renderExtra with tooltip extra area, allows custom interactive content per step

interactions.name: show_on_launch
interactions.action: Flips boolean, read via getShowOnLaunch() saved as showTutorial preference

states.hidden: Overlay not in DOM or display:none
states.showing: Overlay visible, current step rendered with optional highlight ring
states.first_step: Back button hidden, only Next visible
states.last_step: Next replaced with Done, checkbox visible
states.body_locked: body overflow:hidden when step.overflowHidden is true
